cues.text: The dorm's command room, in front of its wall of monitors. Fuuka is inside her Persona, a tall figure with outstretched arms whose skirt closes around her like a glowing dome. You, Yukari, Junpei, Akihiko, Mitsuru, Aigis and Koromaru stand around her, and Ikutsuki, the chairman, stands by the monitors with his arms crossed.
Junpei turns and walks out of the room.
